reason: I give free meals to creators all the time and never know if anyone comes, so the coupon counter is the one part that interests me. But a beta startup that says it will pay me ₹200 a month for nothing sounds too good, and I'm not handing my Google login and my staff's time to people who could vanish next month.
objection: Who are you? A small new team, Bengaluru only, paying businesses and taking money from creators. If you shut down, my offers and my creator contacts go with you, and my counter boys are stuck with one more PIN system for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Another café or darshini owner I know in my area showing me that real customers walked in with Mitra coupons and the ₹200 actually got paid.
